responsibility: Defines the z13 scheduler model for System z, including mnemonic-to-functional-unit classification attributes (FXA/FXB/FXD, LSU, VFU, FPD) and coarse per-instruction latency buckets used by the S/390 backend. It is the tuning description that lets GCC account for z13-era scalar, floating-point, and vector facility execution characteristics when scheduling machine instructions.
